realmRemap.mechanism: Non-Classic realms set --text-hue and --text-chroma; theme-palettes.css rebuilds --color-amber-50..950 and --accent-* in OKLCH with amber's lightness, so one class set restyles every realm. Dark (Classic) and Light keep Tailwind's amber.

tagline.purpose: Predict. Play. Prevail. under the wordmark.

headline.purpose: The closing station heading at the table.

body.purpose: Running text and primary button lettering.

body-small.purpose: Ledger labels, secondary buttons, search results.

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--color-amber-50, #fffbeb); background: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-amber-600, #d97706) 62%, #1a1108) 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-amber-800, #92400e) 78%, #100a04) 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-amber-400, #fbbf24) 55%, transparent), inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-amber-200, #fde68a) 30%, transparent), 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d4a853; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-dock { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--surface-border, rgba(180,83,9,0.3)); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface, rgba(26,21,16,0.92)) 88%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.45); } .ds-dock-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; width: 14rem; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-amber-700, #b45309) 30%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--page-base, #080706) 70%, transparent); color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-amber-300, #fcd34d) 80%, transparent); } .ds-dock-search:focus-within { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-amber-400, #fbbf24) 70%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-amber-400, #fbbf24) 30%, transparent); } .ds-dock-search input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-amber-50, #fffbeb); } .ds-dock-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-amber-200, #fde68a) 90%, transparent); cursor: pointer; } .ds-dock-btn:hover { color: var(--color-amber-50, #fffbeb); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-amber-900, #78350f) 35%, transparent); } .ds-dock-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d4a853; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-lenses { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-lens { width: 44px; height: 44px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%, #1f7a4a 0%, #14583a 48%, #0d3b27 62%, #5a2a14 64%, #2e140a 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); transition: transform 0.2s; } .ds-lens-alt { background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%, #4a2a6a 0%, #321a4a 48%, #22102e 62%, #3a2010 64%, #1a0c06 100%); } .ds-lens[aria-pressed="true"] { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #d4a853, 0 0 18px #d4a853; } .ds-lens:hover { transform: scale(1.1); } .ds-lens:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fcd34d; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-lens:hover { transform: none; } }

components.css: .ds-loader { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 20px 10px 12px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--surface-border, rgba(180,83,9,0.3)); background: var(--surface, rgba(26,21,16,0.92)); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.55); font-family: Georgia, serif; } .ds-loader-cards { position: relative; width: 44px; height: 48px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-card { position: absolute; left: 10px; top: 4px; width: 24px; height: 36px; border-radius: 5px; border: 1px solid rgba(252,211,77,0.7); background: linear-gradient(160deg, #b45309, #451a03); box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); animation: ds-shuffle 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-c1 { --x: -6px; --r: -12deg; transform: translateX(-6px) rotate(-12deg); } .ds-c2 { --x: 0px; --r: 0deg; z-index: 2; animation-delay: 0.12s; } .ds-c3 { --x: 6px; --r: 12deg; transform: translateX(6px) rotate(12deg); animation-delay: 0.24s; } @keyframes ds-shuffle { 0%, 100% { transform: translateX(var(--x)) rotate(var(--r)); } 50% { transform: translateX(calc(var(--x) * -1)) rotate(calc(var(--r) * -1)); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-card { animation: none; } } .ds-loader-title { display: block; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-amber-100, #fef3c7); } .ds-loader-line { display: block; font-size: 0.75rem; font-style: italic; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-amber-200, #fde68a) 75%, transparent); }

narrative.overview:
Wizard Party is a card room you walk into, not a dashboard you read. The backdrop of the start page is the active realm's own 3D game room and table (the same ThemedEnvironment, SceneLighting and TableSurface the game draws, under a warm fill light), and the camera moves through it as the page scrolls until it rests at the player's seat. Everything readable sits on top of that room in a single voice: Georgia serif, sentence case, warm amber lettering on near-black.

The system is one class set over eleven realms. The UI never names a realm colour; it paints with the amber scale, `--page-base`, `--surface`, `--surface-border` and `--glow`, and each realm (Classic, Halloween, Autumn, Winter, Spring, Summer, Manga, Neon, Pixel, Celestial, Solarpunk) remaps those tokens. Classic is the reference rendering and the values in the frontmatter are Classic's.

Density is low and deliberate: one reading panel per stop, sequences told in running type, figures shown as label-and-value ledgers. Depth comes from the real room behind the page and from soft, deep black shadows under the panels, never from stacked tinted cards.
keyCharacteristics: The realm's real game room is the backdrop; the page is a walk through it.
Georgia serif for every word of UI, at regular weight; hierarchy by size, colour and space.
One remappable amber scale restyles every realm with no per-realm component code.
Opaque reading panels with a brass hairline; translucent blurred surfaces only for floating chrome.
Muted aged-brass primary action with cream lettering, shared by the start page and the lobby.
44px minimum hit area on every control.

rules.name: The Remap Rule
rules.body: UI colour comes only from the amber scale and the page tokens (`--page-base`, `--surface`, `--surface-border`, `--glow`, `--text-muted`, `--accent-*`). A raw realm hex in a component breaks ten of the eleven realms.

rules.name: The Cream On Brass Rule
rules.body: The primary button is dark brass with cream text. Do not brighten it into a saturated gold fill; the lit table is the brightest thing on screen.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Every user-facing word is Georgia serif at regular weight. The global stylesheet still defaults to Inter, so a new component opts in to the serif explicitly (the shared `SERIF` style); forgetting it is a visible defect.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings are sentence case at heading scale and stand alone: no small uppercase labels above them, no tracked caps as section markers.

rules.name: The No Card Grid Rule
rules.body: Sequences are written as numbered running type (How to win), figures as label-and-value ledgers with hairline dividers (Chronicles). Do not lay content out as a grid of equal tinted cards.

rules.name: The Opaque Reading Rule
rules.body: Text that is read, not glanced at, sits on solid page-base. Blur and translucency are for chrome.

dos: Do paint with the amber scale and the page tokens so all eleven realms restyle the component for free.
Do set every word in Georgia serif at regular weight, headings in sentence case at heading scale.
Do put reading content on an opaque page-base panel with a brass-600 35% hairline and 24px corners.
Do use the shared aged-brass primary style (`GOLD_BUTTON_STYLE`) for the single main action, with cream text.
Do use amber-700 50% outline buttons for secondary actions.
Do give every control a hit area of at least 44px.
Do respect reduced motion: no camera ease, bounce or shuffle when it is set.
donts: Don't hard-code a realm colour in a component; it breaks every other realm.
Don't add small uppercase labels or tracked caps above headings.
Don't lay out sequences or statistics as a grid of equal cards; use running type and ledgers.
Don't brighten the primary button into a saturated gold fill or add a second primary on the same view.
Don't put reading text on translucent or blurred surfaces over the 3D room.
Don't use Gelasio in the live UI; it exists only for the generated link previews.
